card.name: Words leading into 'recently' or 'in the past'
card.fires_on: Small words just before an expected 'recently', 'now', 'past' or 'previous' time phrase, such as 'until', 'up until', 'quite', 'in the'. It marks the spot where a recent-time word is likely to come next.

modes.label: Until / quite before recently
modes.description: The word 'until' or 'quite' where 'recently' or 'now' is likely to follow.
modes.example: gas poisoning remained a major case of death in Korea until<< quite>> recently.

modes.label: In the previous/past period
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'in' before a past-time span like 'previous 5 weeks' or 'past'.
modes.example: has taken it in<< the>> previous 5 weeks.

modes.label: Just a few years ago
modes.description: Words right before 'a few years ago' or 'just decades ago' that mark a recent time.
modes.example: would have been unheard<< of>> just decades ago.

card.writes: It pushes the model to write 'recently' or 'recent' next and to avoid 'where'.
card.plain: It fires on little words that tell the reader a 'recently' or 'in the past' time phrase is coming.
